Measurement traps: Laplace smoothing, hash-truncated DOM, small per-stratum counts create systematic 0.3-0.7 bit null bias (|perm-analytic|<0.03, |null|<0.1 required); without exact Gamma-ratio centering BC>0.05 is uninterpretable — prior, not SPIDER evidence

End-to-end economics: per-hit token cost and Pareto M_total diverge; amortized compilation O(1) $0.002-0.092 at f=10/100 beats retrieval only if verification+freshness excluded; residual-novelty rho>=0.60 is stronger pay-cost-of-novelty test than raw success margin — prior, not SPIDER evidence

Cross-task transfer evaluation requires website/family holdout with disjoint alphabets and trajectory-grouped resampling (block permutation); single-store WebArena-Verified shopping without site diversity inflates duplication 0.9479 and hides parameterization necessity — prior, not SPIDER evidence
